history_summary.value: A French regional variant of the Langshan breed, descended from birds imported to England from China in 1872 and later raised around Estaires in the Nord-Pas-de-Calais region. A breeders' club was formed in 1999, and the breed has been under regional genetic conservation protection since 2004.
